messages:
maria: Morning — finalizing this Thursday's release train. Window is 09:30–11:30 PT. I want to slot three deploys: feature/llm-cache (kevin), infra/kv-cache-ttl (sheru), ui/release-410 (natalie). Can owners confirm smoke steps, rollback commands, and on-call coverage? I'll be on Q for smoke at 10:00 PT.

kevin: I can take feature/llm-cache. Plan: push canary to canary-A (us-west1) at 09:40, promote at 10:10 if green. Smoke checklist in order: 
1) healthcheck POST /v1/health -> 200
2) sample generation at /v1/generate (small prompt)
3) perf sanity: 50 RPS for 2 min
Rollback: tag -> v1.2.3; undo with `kubectl rollout undo deploy/llm-cache`
I'll post smoke logs to the deploy thread.

sheru: Taking infra/kv-cache-ttl. Preflight DB migration scheduled 09:45 PT (no downtime expected). Smoke: run `redis-cli --cluster info` and run short load script `./scripts/smoke_kv.sh`. Script (local):
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
redis-cli ping
./bench_tool --keys 1000 --qps 200 --duration 60
```
Rollback: restore from snapshot if migration shop shows regressions; run `kubectl rollout undo statefulset/kv-cache` if needed. I'll freeze autoscaler during the migration window.

natalie: I'll own ui/release-410 and aim for 10:50 PT canary in west2, promote at 11:10. Smoke is manual QA + automated e2e: `yarn test:smoke --ci`. No DB migration for UI. Rollback: revert frontend tag and invalidate CDN (edge purge command in runbook). I'll be online 10:30–12:00 PT.

maria: Great — pairing: kevin -> canary-A (us-west1), sheru -> canary-B (us-east1), natalie -> canary-C (us-west2). Backup owners: kevin backup is @sheru, sheru backup is @kevin, natalie backup is @maria. Please add your smoke owner and rollback owner to the release board. Quick checklist I need before 09:15 PT: runbooks uploaded, monitoring dashboards shared, alert thresholds set, oncall informed (#eng-oncall).

kevin: @maria noted. I'll add my smoke/runbook. Also adding a small throttling flag in case of token storm: `--max-concurrency=200`. :thumbsup:

sheru: I'll POST to infra API to freeze autoscaler and set maintenance flag: `curl -X POST https://infra.prod/api/maintenance -d '{"freeze":true}'` (I know this is noisy — will revert after promotion).

deploy-bot: Slot confirmed for thread 1777777777 — entries added to release board: https://releases.redwood/board/1777777 :white_check_mark:

maria: Final call — if anything slips, fallback is to pause rollout and rollback the last deploy. If all good, I'll trigger the release conductor at 09:30 PT. Thanks everyone — please post final runbook links in this thread. :rocket:
